verdict.rationale: jo is a personal AI agent with its own browser, so a deep-research capability is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only documents briefings, channel catch-up summaries, scheduled jobs and overnight preparation. Nothing documents an autonomous multi-source research run that returns a cited report. Having a browser is an adjacent capability and does not count as deep research.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report
